<function name="AddOrGetMenu" parent="DMenuBar" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Retrieves a <page>DMenu</page> object from the menu bar. If one with the given label doesn't exist, a new one is created.

To add a DMenu without checking, use <page>DMenuBar:AddMenu</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="label" type="string">The name (label) of the derma menu to get or create.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Panel">The <page>DMenu</page> with the given label.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
